description: This file defines a Java class UpdateLoanProductCommandHandler responsible for handling update commands for loan products within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands using a write platform service, and is annotated as a Spring Service with transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateLoanProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to update loan products, delegating the actual update operation to the LoanProductWritePlatformService.

methods.name: UpdateLoanProductCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the LoanProductWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by invoking the write platform service to perform the loan product update and returns the result.
